strings.subtitle: — Chiphuluski cha Fayilo —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Koka kulije. Gwiritsani ntchito batani pasi.
strings.shred_button: P H U L U S K A
strings.ssd_warning: Chenjezo! Pa SSD, njira iyi yikukhumba kuti yiphuluske chifukwa cha TRIM. Pulogalamu iyi ni ya HDD pera.
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS njira zinyake za data (ADS) zikugwira ntchito yayi.
• USN jarida likusezgeka yayi.
• Makopi ghachisyu na sinkronizasi ya wingu
  (OneDrive na vinyake) vikukhuzgika yayi.
strings.status_full: Vili mukati vyose vyasinthika na ziro. Vingazgoka yayi — vinthu vingawona ziro pera.
strings.status_fast: Mutu, mchira na mizere ya 4 MB yasinthika. Vyakukwana vikukhuzgika yayi, kweni chifukwa cha malo, fayilo yingazgoka yayi yose. Pa makalata ghachisisi gwiritsani ntchito ndondomeko YOSE.
strings.status_empty: Fayilo yikaŵa palije, kusintha kukukhumbika yayi. Yiphuluskika.
strings.error_permission: Yikuzomerezgeka yayi kufika pa fayilo. Yikukhoza kuŵa yijulika mu pulogalamu yinyake. Jalanizgani na yesesani.
strings.error_not_found: Fayilo yikusangika yayi. Yikukhoza kuŵa yiphuluskika kale.
strings.error_is_symlink: Iyi ni njira ya chizindikiro. Njira zikuzomerezgeka yayi kuphuluska — fayilo ya chilango yikukhalapo.
strings.error_reparse: Iyi ni fayilo ya nyengo (OneDrive na vinyake). Data yake ili mu wingu, yayi pa disk — palije chakiphuluska.
strings.error_not_file: Iyi ni fayilo yayi (folda panji chinyake). Kokani fayilo.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fayilo iyi yili na njira zinyake zakukhora ({n} zose). Njira zakukhora zilije njira yikuru — mazina ghose ghakuyana. Mukaphuluska na njira iyi, data yisinthika na kuchepeskeka ku 32 byte, kweni yijulika na njira zinyake. Phuluskani njira zose chakwamba.
strings.error_compressed:
Fayilo yikukaka, yikusimbika panji sparse. Kusintha na ziro kukukhumba yayi kuphuluska data yakale chifukwa NTFS yikusunga mwakupambana.

Chotsani sifa: dinani kumanja → Sifa → Kwakupambana → chotsani "Kaka" na/panji "Simba". Kesi gwiritsani ntchito SHREDDER.
